description: For a table, dynaset, snapshot and forward-only recordset on T in turn: read Bookmarkable, Bookmark at the first row, MoveNext, Bookmark, MoveFirst, Bookmark, LastModified. Then on a dynaset at ID 2, assign Bookmark the constants: empty byte array, four zero bytes, empty string, Long 1, Null and Empty, reading BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition and Fields("ID").Value after each. Asks the exact bookmark VARIANT per type, whether revisiting a row returns equal bytes, and how malformed bookmarks are refused. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: R-ORACLE-1 OR-REUSE (tdt9): fresh against one reused worker with release-bindings/1, forward and reverse order
